tools.description:
Add another subscription to a webhook. This endpoint accepts both PATCH and PUT. The request body is a single subscription object. degree_days.available: This subscription is sent after the degree day calculation for a model run has completed. The payload identifies the matching model run whose population-weighted HDD and CDD forecasts are available. events.available: Receive a notification when atmospheric river, heatwave, coldwave, and front products are published for a model run and can be queried through the Events API. By default, one notification waits for all four types from the same initialization. Subscribe to specific types to receive their notifications independently, without waiting for the others. Each notification covers a complete forecast, not one individual event or forecast hour. forecast_hour.available: This subscription sends a notification for each individual forecast output as it becomes available. The payload includes the model, initialization time, forecast zero, forecast hour, and the time at which the forecast is valid. initialization_time.available: The forecast cycle is complete when every expected forecast hour for a model run is available. The payload includes the model, initialization time, and forecast zero. tropical_cyclones.available: This subscription is sent once tropical cyclone forecasts have been published for a matching model run. The payload includes the model, initialization time, forecast zero, and tropical cyclone IDs even when no response option is configured.

Documentation: https://api.windbornesystems.com/webhooks/version_1/subscriptions/add-subscription/

Default endpoint: https://api.windbornesystems.com/webhooks/v1/{id}/subscriptions

subscription_type.description: The subscription type to add (e.g. forecast_hour.available). degree_days.available: This subscription is sent after the degree day calculation for a model run has completed. The payload identifies the matching model run whose population-weighted HDD and CDD forecasts are available. events.available: Receive a notification when atmospheric river, heatwave, coldwave, and front products are published for a model run and can be queried through the Events API. By default, one notification waits for all four types from the same initialization. Subscribe to specific types to receive their notifications independently, without waiting for the others. Each notification covers a complete forecast, not one individual event or forecast hour. forecast_hour.available: This subscription sends a notification for each individual forecast output as it becomes available. The payload includes the model, initialization time, forecast zero, forecast hour, and the time at which the forecast is valid. initialization_time.available: The forecast cycle is complete when every expected forecast hour for a model run is available. The payload includes the model, initialization time, and forecast zero. tropical_cyclones.available: This subscription is sent once tropical cyclone forecasts have been published for a matching model run. The payload includes the model, initialization time, forecast zero, and tropical cyclone IDs even when no response option is configured.

note.description: Free-text label included in every outgoing payload for this subscription.

filters.description: Filters for this subscription type.If omitted, all notifications for the subscription type are delivered. Supported filters and examples are included in this argument's schema. Allowed filter keys by subscription: degree_days.available: model, initialization_time_hours, min_initialization_time, max_initialization_time, min_valid_at, max_valid_at; events.available: model, event_type, initialization_time_hours, min_initialization_time, max_initialization_time, min_valid_at, max_valid_at, min_latitude, max_latitude, min_longitude, max_longitude; forecast_hour.available: model, forecast_hour, initialization_time_hours, min_initialization_time, max_initialization_time, min_valid_at, max_valid_at; initialization_time.available: model, initialization_time_hours, min_initialization_time, max_initialization_time, min_valid_at, max_valid_at; tropical_cyclones.available: model, initialization_time_hours, min_initialization_time, max_initialization_time, min_valid_at, max_valid_at.

model.description: Per-subscription semantics: degree_days.available: Forecast model whose completed degree-day calculations should trigger the subscription.Any model with degree-day calculations enabled is supported. Omit this filter to use wm-6 . forecast_hour.available: Models to match.Options: wm-6 and wm-6-3km . An array matches any listed model; omit the filter to receive both. Use separate webhooks for model-specific schedules. initialization_time.available: Model runs to match.Options: wm-6 and wm-6-3km . An array matches any listed model; omit the filter to receive both. Use separate webhooks for model-specific schedules. tropical_cyclones.available: Forecast model whose completed tropical cyclone calculations should trigger the subscription.Currently only wm-6 is supported. Omit this filter to use wm-6 .

initialization_time_hours.description: Per-subscription semantics: degree_days.available, events.available, forecast_hour.available, initialization_time.available, tropical_cyclones.available: UTC times of day matched against the hour and minute of initialization_time . min_initialization_time.description: Per-subscription semantics: degree_days.available, events.available, forecast_hour.available, initialization_time.available, tropical_cyclones.available: Inclusive ISO 8601 lower bound for the run's initialization_time .

max_initialization_time.description: Per-subscription semantics: degree_days.available, events.available, forecast_hour.available, initialization_time.available, tropical_cyclones.available: Inclusive ISO 8601 upper bound for the run's initialization_time .

min_valid_at.description: Per-subscription semantics: degree_days.available: Inclusive ISO 8601 start of the required validity window.The source model run must include the selected time within its forecast range. This does not filter individual calendar dates from the HDD or CDD response. events.available: Inclusive ISO 8601 lower bound on when an event is forecast to occur. Return only IDs with a published forecast-hour sample or interval overlapping the requested window. forecast_hour.available: Inclusive ISO 8601 lower bound for the forecast output's valid_at . initialization_time.available, tropical_cyclones.available: Inclusive ISO 8601 start of the required validity window.The new run must include the selected time within its forecast range.

max_valid_at.description: Per-subscription semantics: degree_days.available: Inclusive ISO 8601 end of the required validity window.The source model run must include the selected time within its forecast range. This does not filter individual calendar dates from the HDD or CDD response. events.available: Inclusive ISO 8601 upper bound on when an event is forecast to occur. Heatwave and coldwave intervals include their start but exclude their period_end . forecast_hour.available: Inclusive ISO 8601 upper bound for the forecast output's valid_at . initialization_time.available, tropical_cyclones.available: Inclusive ISO 8601 end of the required validity window.The new run must include the selected time within its forecast range.

event_type.description: Per-subscription semantics: events.available: all (the default) waits for all four types and sends their IDs together. Select atmospheric_river , heatwave , coldwave , or front for independent per-type notifications. Use all alone, not mixed with specific types. front includes cold, warm, stationary, and occluded fronts.

min_latitude.description: Per-subscription semantics: events.available: Southern edge of the bounding box, -90 to 90. Supply all four geographic bounds together.

max_latitude.description: Per-subscription semantics: events.available: Northern edge of the bounding box, -90 to 90; must exceed min_latitude .

min_longitude.description: Per-subscription semantics: events.available: Western edge of the bounding box, -180 to 180.

max_longitude.description: Per-subscription semantics: events.available: Eastern edge of the bounding box, -180 to 180. A value below min_longitude selects a box crossing the antimeridian.

forecast_hour.description: Per-subscription semantics: forecast_hour.available: Forecast hours to match.An array matches any listed hour. When model and forecast_hour are both set, an event must match both filters. Common values: 0 , 3 , 6 , 12 , 24 , 48 , 72 , 120 , 240 , and 360 . Omit the filter to receive every output.

tools.description:
WindBorne observations are high-frequency, at once every ten seconds, but as our balloons are comparatively slow-moving (relative to the distances at which weather changes), this may be excessive for some applications. Indeed, previous data assimilation experiments have suggested that reducing the resolution of the dataset helps with impact.

Documentation: https://api.windbornesystems.com/observations/version_1/observations/super-observations/

Default endpoint: https://api.windbornesystems.com/observations/v1/super_observations

since.description: Pagination cursor as a unix timestamp. Use a beginning timestamp to start from a known point. The response includes 'next_since' - pass that value as 'since' in your next request to get the next page. Check 'has_next_page' in the response to know when to stop. Note: Returns data that is new or updated since this timestamp. (Format: unix timestamp)

min_time.description: A unix timestamp (seconds since unix epoch) for filtering by observation time. Only returns observations taken at or after this value. Note: This filters by when the observation was taken, unlike 'since' which is used for pagination. (Format: unix timestamp)

max_time.description: A unix timestamp (seconds since unix epoch) for filtering data. Note: If provided, will only return observations taken at a timestamp less than or equal to this value. (Format: unix timestamp)

include_ids.description: If true, will include the id of the observation and the mission that collected it. (Format: boolean)

include_mission_name.description: If true, will include the human name of the mission that collected the observation. (Format: boolean)

include_updated_at.description: If true, will include when the observation was last updated in the database (eg from a re-processing of sensor data). (Format: boolean)

mission_id.description: If set, will filter to only missions with this ID. IDs can be found via the flying missions route. (Format: UUID)

min_latitude.description: If provided, will only return observations with a latitude greater than or equal to this value. (Format: degrees)

max_latitude.description: If provided, will only return observations with a latitude less than or equal to this value. (Format: degrees)

min_longitude.description: If provided, will only return observations with a longitude greater than or equal to this value. Uses the -180 to 180 convention. (Format: degrees)

max_longitude.description: If provided, will only return observations with a longitude less than or equal to this value. Uses the -180 to 180 convention. (Format: degrees)

tools.description:
Discover which atmospheric soundings have been collected by WindBorne's global balloon constellation. This endpoint allows you to search for soundings by time, location, altitude, and mission, making it easy to discover which soundings are available before fetching the full sounding data.

Documentation: https://api.windbornesystems.com/observations/version_1/soundings/all-soundings/

Default endpoint: https://api.windbornesystems.com/observations/v1/soundings

mission_id.description: Filter to only soundings collected by the specified mission. Note: Mission IDs can be obtained via the flying missions route. (Format: UUID)

min_time.description: Filter to soundings that started at or after this timestamp. (Format: ISO 8601)

max_time.description: Filter to soundings that ended at or before this timestamp. (Format: ISO 8601)
